name: isidore-index
description: Every book record in the St. Isidore (isidore.co) Calibre library, normalized: canonical languages, author era, rights status, and deep links. Files stay on isidore.co; file links are given only for public-domain, openly licensed, or permitted records.

fields.title: title as catalogued
fields.curated_author_ids: ids of matching pages in authors.json
fields.catalog_year: Calibre pubdate year; often a scan or reprint date, NOT evidence of copyright status
fields.subjects: Calibre tags (up to 6, most common first)
fields.isidore_files_url: folder of files on isidore.co; empty unless rights_status is public_domain_us, open_license, or permission_granted
fields.download_urls: per-format download URLs on isidore.co; empty unless rights_status is public_domain_us, open_license, or permission_granted
fields.rights_status: public_domain_us, open_license, permission_granted, link_only, or unknown (see /rights; not legal advice). Only the first three may be downloaded or read here
fields.rights_evidence: why the record has that status: a lead to check, a presumption, or written evidence
fields.rights_checked: date the status was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.editorial_flag: editorial category if the record carries a context note (see #/policy); listing is not endorsement
fields.context_note: short factual context note shown on the record page
